purpose: Qualify source-attributed, time-bounded and purpose-limited fraud evidence for future federated payment coordination.

source_register.title: Payments Ecosystem Modernisation Position Paper
supports: The proposed National Payments Utility could provide baseline fraud protection
The proposal includes participant reporting of suspected and actual fraudulent transactions
The position paper proposes transaction-level fraud scoring across channels and participants
does_not_support: That a national fraud-scoring API is currently operational
That a score or report proves fraud or liability

source_register.title: PEM Industry Dialogue, 9 April 2026
supports: SARB reported a fraud framework developed with priority items being scoped
The insights-platform stakeholder alignment remained in progress
does_not_support: An operational national risk-scoring service or production SLA

source_register.title: Payments Ecosystem Modernisation Working Groups
supports: A Fraud and Intelligence Information Sharing Forum is described for private-sector PEM participants
does_not_support: That Mycelix is a participant or endorsed provider

source_register.title: Enhancing Cross-border Payments: Fast Payment System Interlinking
supports: Fraud/scam unhappy paths require clear inter-PSP responsibilities and recovery paths
Fraud information sharing and cross-institution coordination are important design considerations
does_not_support: A universal global risk score or liability allocation

profiles.admission: programme design evidence only; no operational service or interface claim
